title: 21yo Learning Her Lesson The Hard Way
description:
#cops #police #arrest

Officers were flagged down by a lifeguard regarding a highly intoxicated woman who was causing a major disturbance on the beach. It was said that she was being verbal towards an innocent family, and even stepped up to an older lady and pushed her. The lady then punched her and that's when things escalated.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
